verdict.rationale: Retries and checkpoint resume are a fair question for a data orchestrator like Dagster, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions retry policies, automatic retries on transient failures, or resuming interrupted runs or syncs from a checkpoint. The schedules, sensors, alerts and Airbyte/Fivetran/dlt sync-triggering items are adjacent features and do not show this capability.

support.subject: As a data engineer, transient failures retry automatically and interrupted syncs resume from checkpoints instead of restarting
